FROM (
    SELECT match_id, striker_id
    FROM Deliveries
    GROUP BY match_id, inning, striker_id
    HAVING SUM(runs_scored) >= 100

JOIN Players p ON p.player_id = centuries.striker_id
GROUP BY centuries.match_id, centuries.striker_id
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 2;

    SUM(d.runs_scored) * 1.0 / NULLIF(
        (SELECT COUNT(*) 
         FROM Deliveries x 
         WHERE x.player_out_id = p.player_id), 0
    ) AS batting_average
FROM Deliveries d
JOIN Players p ON d.striker_id = p.player_id
JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
WHERE d.batting_team = 'England'
  AND d.inning = 2
GROUP BY p.player_id, p.player_name
ORDER BY batting_average DESC
LIMIT 1;

    AND m.result_type IN ('runs', 'wickets')  -- conclusive result

ORDER BY wins DESC
LIMIT 1;

  WHERE result_type = 'innings'

    AND strftime('%Y', start_date) > '2015'

ORDER BY wins DESC

FROM Players p
JOIN (
    SELECT player_out_id, match_id, inning
    FROM Deliveries
    WHERE player_out_id IS NOT NULL
      AND wicket_type NOT IN ('retired hurt', 'retired out', 'timed out', 'hit the ball twice')
    GROUP BY match_id, inning, player_out_id
    HAVING SUM(runs_scored) = 0
) d_out ON p.player_id = d_out.player_out_id
JOIN Matches m ON d_out.match_id = m.match_id
WHERE strftime('%Y', m.start_date) > '2015'
GROUP BY p.player_id, p.pl
